reviews.text:
Girl power! I've been going there for several years; they took care of my English bulldog through his minor ailments and, sadly, also during his final journey. Bérangère supported me with gentleness and kindness, sharing my grief at losing my little angel, Marcel.
They're now taking care of the next generation and the cat too, so I'll continue to go there with complete peace of mind. They listen to me, and I admit I can be a bit stubborn when it comes to his care!
Martine and Annie are very kind and offer excellent advice. What more could you ask for!

The Mazargues clinic is one of the best veterinary clinics in Marseille.
Drs. Poletti and Amos are truly very friendly and professional; they are very able to offer treatments that fit your budget without pressuring you.
It's one of the few independent veterinary clinics in Marseille.
The veterinary assistants are also highly skilled professionals, and you can count on them for personalized advice. A fantastic clinic, and don't hesitate to contact them if you have any veterinary needs!

I recommend them 1000%! They are adorable and caring. My daughter came today to drop off a kitten she found, and they took care of it immediately. Bravo! A wonderful team that takes great care of animals.

I wholeheartedly recommend this veterinary clinic!

A huge thank you to the entire team for the incredible care they provided for my little cat, Mimi. It was her very first visit to a vet, and everything went perfectly. I was quite apprehensive, but the whole team knew how to put her at ease with so much gentleness and patience. She wasn't traumatized at all; quite the opposite, in fact.

They microchipped her, vaccinated her, dewormed her, and spayed her, all at a very affordable price. At every appointment, Mimi was treated with great care and kindness. Animal welfare is clearly their priority.

I also greatly appreciated the time they took to answer all my questions and reassure me. You can tell that the whole team is passionate, competent, and deeply committed to the well-being of animals.

For me, it's simply the best veterinary clinic in Marseille. I trust them completely and recommend them 100%. Thank you so much for everything you've done for Mimi!
Thank you for your kindness, thank you for taking the time. Guizmo has passed away peacefully.
Amazing vet! 🥰 Claire is so kind and gentle! Thank you! 🙏 …
Mr. Gentil is very kind....

A very pleasant first meeting for Petite Lucette and myself with Dr. Amos and his colleague.
They provided excellent listening and support.
A contact that Petite Lucette and I will treasure.

Excellent veterinary clinic! Our dogs are treated there, and after a litter, the vets were incredibly kind!

Unlike many clinics, if you have a problem and you call, they don't tell you to come in for every little thing. We always get a personal consultation with the vet, and they only ask you to come in if it's truly necessary!

The vets and assistants are incredibly professional and empathetic. You can tell they love animals more than anything, and it's heartwarming!

My 4-year-old dog recently developed epilepsy, and I went to this clinic for the first time hoping for a competent veterinarian. Dr. Amos and her assistant took care of him with great patience, gentleness, and kindness, as he is very fearful. They are exceptional and very professional. You can tell they practice their profession with a lot of love. We were very well received; Dr. Amos really took her time to examine him and give me very clear explanations. Furthermore, the office is impeccably clean. I left this clinic feeling very reassured, and my dog ​​now has a top-notch veterinarian. I highly recommend this clinic.

I thank the entire team, and especially the veterinarian who allowed my cat Baloo to pass away peacefully. She was there for me during this difficult time, finding just the right words. I was deeply touched by her empathy.

Incompetence like I've rarely seen. A simple spaying turned into a nightmare for my dog: two general anesthetics and two surgeries in three weeks, a bandage soaked in blood the day after the second operation!! Which, by the way, was absolutely unnecessary for my dog's well-being!!! The goal of this second operation? To line their pockets!! No awareness of the danger or the animal's suffering!!
A real butchery, done by the book!!! You don't even deserve one star

An exceptionally caring team! That's an understatement.
This is my third pet, and I've never seen a clinic so attentive and available.
The first appointment lasted over an hour and a half, with tons of advice, no judgment, and genuine listening.
You immediately feel like you're in good hands.
You can feel their passion for animals: the whole team is dedicated and comes to greet the dog, which instantly puts you at ease.
My puppy wasn't traumatized at all after his first vaccination; on the contrary, he was relaxed when he left.

And they even gave me little extras as I left! ❤️

Thank you to the whole team for your kindness, your smiles, and your professionalism! 🙏🐾

A TEAM THAT MAKES YOU HAVE RENEWED YOUR TRUST IN VETERINARY CLINICS!
I wish I'd known about them sooner.

They clearly have a wonderful approach with both the client and the animal. They are genuinely kind people at every stage. My ten-year-old Labrador was treated with such care; you can go there with complete confidence! You'll have a caring and attentive team. Keep up the good work, guys!
The staff were attentive; I didn't have an appointment and they accepted me, pleasant and friendly.

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic. My cat had an accident, and they were incredibly responsive, professional, and took excellent care of her. Later, she developed another problem, and she was immediately treated again without any additional charges. It's wonderful to find such competent veterinarians who truly care about animal welfare, not just profit. I'm so glad that Cacahuète is now being cared for by you. Thank you so much for everything you've done for her. See you soon.

My dog ​​Yuna loves coming to this clinic! She's always very well received and pampered, and there are always treats 😝. The vets are also very competent and give excellent advice. I highly recommend it! …
Excellent veterinary clinic, friendly, kind, attentive and professional staff! I highly recommend it!

A competent, patient, efficient, and attentive team. And yet, it was a delicate procedure for a severe case of conjunctivitis in our very nervous and difficult-to-treat dog... Comprehensive care. Perfect!
Excellent veterinary clinic with highly competent vets. It's very reassuring for us and our pets!
Thank you for your professionalism.
Excellent clinic, very professional and friendly. You can really tell that all the staff love our animal friends, which is wonderful. Prices are reasonable.
Excellent vets, I highly recommend this clinic 😄 …

Excellent veterinary clinic! Drs. Amos and Poletti have been treating Iska for several years: they are simply wonderful. Gentle, caring, always attentive, incredibly competent and kind—I trust them completely.

Today, we had the opportunity to meet a new veterinarian on the team: she is just as fantastic, in the same vein, very professional, gentle, and reassuring. Each veterinarian always takes the time to explain everything; you never feel rushed.
A special mention also goes to the rest of the staff, who are always warm, friendly, and efficient both in person and on the phone. Thank you to the entire team for your support and kindness, both towards the animals and their owners.
